scope: Authored storage/response connections, prepared range semantics, lifetime correctness; no performance comparison
limitations: Fixed byte-range authoring profile, not the general application language or graph runtime
One registered storage effect per handler; constant ranges, no dynamic branches or feedback loops
The native connection authoring parser is separate from the existing UI/scalar parser
runtime_view_steps is a structural description, not a measured instruction count
Logical payload bounds exclude mmap page rounding, page cache, disk retention, sockets and client allocations
Selecting input bytes for a reply retains and charges the complete original receive allocation
Synchronous storage calls delay other connections and timeout enforcement
Linux AArch64 only; macOS and real power loss have not been tested
Unpublished files left by crashes have no automatic recovery/collection policy
